parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: The accelerated domain name to query. If you omit this parameter, the operation returns information about all accelerated domain names.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the WAF instance is deployed. You can set this to `cn-hangzhou` (the default). At present, you can only set this to `cn-hangzhou`.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group. If you do not specify this parameter, the system queries the default resource group.
